idea-plugin.name: Enkidu Linkage Doctor
idea-plugin.description: Enkidu catches runtime linkage failures early before they reach production.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • ASM-based bytecode reference extraction in enkidu-core
  • JVM resolution engine that loads symbols from the runtime classpath
  • Hierarchy + interface walk resolution for referenced classes / methods / fields
  • Failure detection for missing symbols, class↔interface mismatches (ICCE), and descriptor mismatches
  • Static-vs-instance field access mismatch detection
  • Actionable, readable reports
  • Fixture-based resolver tests + CLI integration tests (fixtures)
  • Suggested fix validation for fixture failures
  • Exporters (JSON / SARIF / HTML)
  • IntelliJ plugin module
  • Copyable classpath manifest from the IDE for CLI reproduction
  • Compare mode: resolve under two classpaths and report differences

Fixed

  • Consistent internal names for bytecode type-reference recording
  • Tool window layout: configuration options no longer overlap or clip
